title: BSE Q1 Results: Profit soars 62% YoY to Rs 874 crore, revenue surges 63%

title: Sebi proposes depository receipts against REITs, InvITs units
description: India's markets regulator has unveiled a fresh set of regulations concerning depository receipts aimed at real estate and infrastructure investment trusts. This initiative seeks to draw increased foreign investment into these vital sectors, providing overseas investors with a new channel to trade these units. Interested parties must submit their feedback on the proposals by August twenty-fifth.

title: Elon Musk likely to face tough questions during SpaceX's first earnings call after stock market listing

Anticipated insider share sales could amplify trading fluctuations. Investors are particularly interested in Musk's insights on the Starship rocket launch tests and satellite network developments, especially given that SpaceX is grappling with serious financial losses.

title: A crash coming? Ray Dalio warns AI rally looks like 1929 and 2000 bubbles

title: Gaurs Group eyes Rs 1,900 cr revenue from new housing project in Delhi-NCR

This ambitious initiative will feature 1,088 modern apartments, projected to yield impressive revenue of Rs 1,900 crore. Bolstered by strong residential demand, this development underscores Gaurs Group's deep-rooted expertise in the real estate sector.

title: Ajmera Realty & Infra Q1 profit rises 14% to Rs 45cr

Alongside this, the company's total income surged to Rs 319.52 crore in the first quarter, indicating a remarkable year-on-year performance. As one of India's top real estate firms, Ajmera continues to demonstrate robust growth.

Hopes for an imminent Middle East peace deal also contributed to the gains.  Strong earnings from AI companies like Amazon and Microsoft reassured investors about their investments.  The blue-chip Dow Jones Industrial Average also traded at a fresh intraday record high.

title: Keystone Realtors Q1 profit jumps over 3-times to Rs 52cr

Total income soared to Rs 493.26 crore, reflecting healthy demand in the real estate market. Additionally, pre-sales hit Rs 617 crore, buoyed by a robust homebuyer sentiment, while the company ensures a solid financial foundation for upcoming ventures.

title: Godrej Properties Q1 Results: Profit falls 42% to Rs 349 crore, sales bookings rise 22%

However, sales bookings increased by twenty-two percent to over eight thousand six hundred crore. The company sold three thousand seven hundred thirty-eight units during the quarter. Executive Chairperson Pirojsha Godrej expressed confidence in continued sales momentum.

title: Sri Lotus Developers & Realty eyes Rs 1,600 cr revenue from commercial project in Mumbai
